name: Sunflower Pie
source:
A short story about a parasitic sunflower and her loyal son. Eat everything you can. Enjoy the sunshine. Do whatever it takes to make her happy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742040/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
关于寄生向日葵和她忠诚的儿子的短篇故事。能吃的都吃。享受阳光。尽一切努力让她开心。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742040/]Steam[/url]]
